runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game mb_10 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics <7|3> --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-95/mb-dracula-service-test.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. --handle-mechanics 7 enables all three built-in mb_10 mechs (bit 2 is the Dracula mech, the only bit the known-working VPX table sets); --handle-mechanics 3 keeps the up/down-bank and Frankenstein-table mechs so the power-up test report stays empty and menu navigation is identical, but removes Dracula position feedback.
